title: Review and harden quantized-fallback scoring thresholds to prevent cascade regressions
creator: Ava Chen
postmortem_summary: On 2026-02-08 a rollout of a new quant kernel selection heuristic caused an unexpectedly permissive fallback scoring decision for a subset of int4-converted models. The permissive threshold routed production traffic to a fallback variant that did not fully support a fused attention op used by many customer models. As these requests hit the fallback nodes, the fallback variant began failing fast and entering crash/restart loops which triggered autoscaler churn and a capacity cascade. The cascade increased queuing and latency while model responses showed accuracy regressions for several customers. The problem was detected via SLO latency alerts and multiple customer reports. Immediate mitigation involved reverting the heuristic, temporarily pinning affected models to stable int8 variants, and applying an emergency rate limit to fallback routing.
root_cause: A bug in the newly-introduced fallback scoring logic treated partial compatibility signals as full compatibility for certain fused ops. This lowered the decision threshold and allowed unvalidated fallback variants to receive traffic. Additional contributing issues: insufficient op-level reject telemetry, no canary run for mixed-fusion op combinations, and autoscaler policy that reacted to transient crash loops by adding capacity, amplifying the cascade.

action_items: Implement a conservative default fallback_score floor and explicit gating for unvalidated opsets - owner: Liam Rodriguez - due: 2026-03-15
Add op-level rejection telemetry and a 'compatibility fingerprint' emitted at conversion time so we can early-reject incompatible fused ops - owner: Priya Patel - due: 2026-03-22
Design a canary matrix that exercises mixed-fusion op combinations across target hardware profiles before rollout - owner: Marco Silva - due: 2026-03-25
Tune autoscaler to avoid immediate scale-ups on short crash loops; add cooldown and anomaly suppression when crash rates correlate with recent rollouts - owner: SRE Lead - due: 2026-03-18
Create an automated dry-run check in the quant conversion pipeline that compares KV-cache behavior and output distributions against baseline samples - owner: Research/Applied ML - due: 2026-04-01
Document emergency fallback controls and runbook (including temporary rate-limiter steps and model pinning) and schedule tabletop drill - owner: Reliability PM - due: 2026-03-30
notes_and_discussion: PM feedback: prioritize telemetry and gating to prevent user-visible regressions during future rollouts (Rachel Kim - PM)
Design review: ensure console exposes fallback_score and compat_fingerprint for each model in model catalog (Elena Martinez - Design)
Engineering debate: trade-off between permissive fallback for availability vs strict gating for correctness — agreed to adopt conservative defaults and provide explicit operator override
Legal/Compliance: no customer data exfiltration observed; audit logs for the incident uploaded to the compliance bucket
